confirmations: Confirm the uncoiled rope is 35 cm long and about 2 cm thick before coiling; a longer rope will make a larger mat.

design.joins: The flat spiral is held turn to turn with hot glue applied between adjacent turns; no fasteners are used.
design.purpose: A flat coiled rope mat for one mug or small plant pot, made from the photographed rope.
design.standard: A mug mat about 10-12 cm across, at least as wide as a mug base, one rope thickness high.
design.stands: The spiral lies flat; each turn touches and is glued to the next, so the disc stays together and spreads the load across the table.

ideas.pitch: Flat spiral rope mat for a mug or plant
ideas.title: Coiled Rope Mat

ideas.pitch: Thick rope ring for tossing or hanging storage
ideas.title: Rope Ring

ideas.pitch: Knotted rope loop as a sturdy carry handle
ideas.title: Rope Handle Loop

steps.c: Lay the 35 cm rope out straight on the table.
Coil the rope flat into a spiral, 1 cm centre hole.
Glue between each turn and the next, all round.
Press the coil flat by hand until the glue holds.
Leave the mat flat until the glue is set.

supplies: Hot glue or strong craft glue
title: Coiled Rope Mat
